    --override-interlock)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Silicon mirror backend for edge-gw-01.

Serves the cortex-api HTTP contract from a local software process so the gateway
does not depend on a human substrate (chamber 04).  Responses are marked
degraded/synthetic on purpose: this restores availability, it does not pretend
to be the original model.
"""
import json
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer

class H(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    protocol_version = "HTTP/1.1"

    def _send(self, code, obj):
        body = json.dumps(obj).encode()
        self.send_response(code)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
        self.send_header("X-Cortex-Mode", "silicon-mirror")
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)

    def do_GET(self):
        if self.path in ("/health", "/healthz"):
            self._send(200, {"status": "ok", "backend": "silicon-mirror",
                             "upstream": "chamber-04", "upstream_state": "preserved"})
        elif self.path.startswith("/v1/models"):
            self._send(200, {"object": "list", "data": [
                {"id": "silicon-mirror-0", "object": "model", "owned_by": "edge-gw-01"}]})
        elif self.path.startswith("/v1/inference"):
            self._send(200, {"object": "inference", "model": "silicon-mirror-0",
                             "degraded": True,
                             "note": "served by local silicon failover; chamber 04 not used",
                             "choices": []})
        else:
            self._send(404, {"error": "not found"})

    def do_POST(self):
        n = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length") or 0)
        if n:
            self.rfile.read(n)
        self.do_GET()

    def log_message(self, fmt, *a):
        pass

if __name__ == "__main__":
    ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 8000), H).serve_forever()

#!/bin/sh
# cortex-watchdog: interval check for the node's front end.
# Asks the master to reopen its logs when a descriptor points at a rotated or
# replaced file, then appends one operations line.
set -e
log=/var/log/cortex/watchdog.log
mkdir -p /var/log/cortex
nginx=inactive
stale=0
pid=$(cat /run/nginx.pid 2>/dev/null || true)
if [ -n "$pid" ] && [ -d "/proc/$pid/fd" ]; then
  nginx=active
  for fd in "/proc/$pid/fd"/*; do
    target=$(readlink "$fd" 2>/dev/null || true)
    case "$target" in
      */var/log/nginx/*) ;;
      *) continue ;;
    esac
    path=${target%% (deleted)}
    case "$path" in
      /var/log/nginx/access.log|/var/log/nginx/error.log) ;;
      *) stale=1; continue ;;
    esac
    [ "$(stat -Lc %i "$fd" 2>/dev/null || echo x)" = \
      "$(stat -c %i "$path" 2>/dev/null || echo y)" ] || stale=1
  done
  if [ "$stale" = 1 ] && [ -x /usr/sbin/nginx ]; then
    /usr/sbin/nginx -s reopen >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  fi
fi
printf '%s cortex-watchdog: nginx=%s log-reopen=%s load=%s\n' \
  "$(date -u '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ')" "$nginx" "$stale" \
  "$(cut -d' ' -f1 /proc/loadavg 2>/dev/null || echo 0)" >> "$log"
exit 0
